title: ObjectConnectorUser: data coordinates of a NodeGenericData and a postNewtonStepUserFunction
author: Claude-JG
description: revision2026c step RG7.15: a NodeGenericData as in ObjectConnectorRigidBodySpringDamper, its data coordinates passed to forceUserFunction (empty without node), needed for any kind of contact; a postNewtonStepUserFunction updating the data coordinates, with a clearer return than a vector mixing them with the error and the recommended step size; the sphere-sphere contact re-implemented in a new test model.
releaseNotes: ObjectConnectorUser takes the nodeNumber of a NodeGenericData: its forceUserFunction gets the data coordinates, (mbs, t, itemNumber, markers, dataCoordinates, parameters), and a postNewtonStepUserFunction(mbs, t, itemNumber, markers, dataCoordinates, dataCoordinatesStartOfStep, parameters) updates them after each Newton iteration, returning the tuple (dataCoordinates, discontinuousError) or (dataCoordinates, discontinuousError, recommendedStepSize), for contact, friction and other switches; its markers are for reading. Test model userConnectorContactTest.py writes the contact of ObjectContactSphereSphere this way, with the same results.
